meaning:
δι-εγείρω
[in LXX: Jdth.1:4, Est.1:1, 2Ma.7:21 2Mac 15:10, 3Ma.5:15 * ;]
to arouse completely, arouse as from rest or sleep: Luk.8:24; pass., Mrk.4:39, Luk.8:24; of the sea, Jhn.6:18. Metaphorical, of the mind: ἐν ὑπομνήσει, 2Pe.1:13 3:1.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
They came to him, and awoke him, saying, “Master, master, we are dying!” He awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and it…
The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
